replicateSelect.label: Replicate
replicateSelect.helpTable: When this table's reads come from its replica, a copy in the engine's store refreshed on the table's timeliness settings. Default: the source's setting, or the global threshold when it has none.
replicateSelect.helpSource: When reads of this source's tables come from their replicas, copies in the engine's store refreshed on each table's timeliness settings. A table with no setting of its own uses this one. Default: the global threshold.
replicateSelect.helpOptions: Live if possible: read directly from the source; replicated only where the engine cannot read it directly. Hot-N: read directly until N statements read the table within the interval, then from the replica until they fall below half of N; answers from the response cache do not count. Always: always from the replica, the only setting that is a guarantee.
replicateSelect.neverWithLoadProtection: Live if possible cannot be combined with load protection, because a load-protected table is never read live.
replicateSelect.scheduled: Always, source read only on schedule
replicateSelect.helpScheduled: Always, source read only on schedule: reads always come from the replica and a query never causes the source to be read; the scheduler refreshes the replica on the off-peak window, the Cache TTL or the change probe, and at least one of the three is required.
